title: Three witnesses held at gunpoint and given 'anthrax boosters'
summary: UAPGerb tells of Three witnesses held at gunpoint and given 'anthrax boosters', about an unknown time at an unknown place, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: All three of these men directly after their encounters were given what they were told were anthrax vaccine boosters.

plain: An online UFO researcher who goes by UAPGerb, speaking with podcast host Jesse Michels, tells of three men in the US military who saw something strange, were held at gunpoint, and then, he says, were all given shots they were told were anthrax vaccine boosters, a vaccine against a dangerous disease. He links the account to a man named Jonathan Wagant and gives no time or place. If true, it would suggest the military treated these encounters as something to contain and perhaps to hide medically.
